First, note the given date: 08-31-1440 (MM-DD-YYYY).  
16 weeks + 7 days = 16×7 + 7 = 119 days.  
Subtract 119 days from 1440-08-31.  

1440 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and 1440 mod 400 = 0? 1440 mod 400 = 240, but divisible by 4 and 100? Actually 1440 mod 100 = 40, so not a century year, so leap year).  
August 31 is day 244 of leap year (Jan 31 + Feb 29 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 + Aug 31 = 244).  

Day of year 244 minus 119 = day 125.  
Day 125 in leap year: Jan 31 (31) + Feb 29 (60) + Mar 31 (91) + Apr 30 (121) → so day 125 is April 29 (since 121 is Apr 1? Let's check: Jan 31, Feb 29 = 60, Mar 31 = 91, Apr 1 = 92, so Apr 29 = 92 + 28 = 120? Wait, miscalculation).  

Recalc:  
Jan 31 days = 31  
Feb 29 days = 31+29=60  
Mar 31 days = 60+31=91  
Apr 1 = 92, Apr 30 = 121.  
So day 125 = 121 + 4 = Apr 29? No: 121 is Apr 30 (since Apr 1 = 92, Apr 30 = 92+29=121).  
Day 125 = Apr 30 is day 121, so day 125 = May 4 (May 1 = 122, May 2 = 123, May 3 = 124, May 4 = 125).  

Thus new date: 1440-05-04.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1440-05-04
